Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
The The Business Performance department is responsible for enhancing the business success of Plarium by ensuring excellence in the performance on all business aspects including: marketing, games & product design, retention, monetization etc. The department build, operate and optimize the processes across the entire company through top of the art analytical capabilities & product understanding.




Responsibilities

Leverage data to understand our products in depth, identify areas of opportunity, and execute projects to drive growth and engagement of Plarium users.
Work closely with the product teams to analyze existing features and ensure a successful implementation of new features.
Use data to fine-tune and balance the game’s economy, providing economy analysis and drive metrics for revenue optimization.
Evaluating and measuring A/B testing results and trends among our players.
Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and metrics to monitor the performance of our products.
Be an expert on industry trends and the competitor landscape to evolve our thinking.




What we expect

2+ years of analytical work experience, preferably for a web or mobile company/e-commerce/ Online Gaming industry.
BA/B.Sc. in Statistics / Math / Engineering / Economics or other quantitative field.
Strong SQL with experience in querying large, complex data sets.
Strong Excel skill.
Proven experience leading data driven projects from definition




Desired

Advanced knowledge in statistical tools and models- advantage

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
Somos Plexus Tech, una tecnológica con más de 5.000 profesionales desarrollando productos y servicios de innovación que mejoran la vida de personas y compañías.




Apostamos por el talento en desarrollo e integramos perfiles junior en el corazón de nuestros proyectos más innovadores.

Formarás parte activa de proyectos reales y con impacto, desde el primer día y con un equipo que te acompañará en tu evolución.




Nos encontramos ampliando el equipo y por ello buscamos un/a Analista de Datos para trabajar con nosotros.




Los requisitos son los siguientes:




-3 años de experiencia

- Conocimientos técnicos básicos de desarrollo: Java, Python y Shell-Script

- Experiencia en soluciones de mercado:

Typology of investment products

Full Revaluation

-Oracle

-Experiencia en Jira y en metodología Scrum




Ofrecemos:

Te incorporarás a un equipo con experiencia que te ayudará a involucrarte en el proyecto desde el principio. Participarás en proyectos reales, con acompañamiento técnico y apoyo constante.




· Te formarás en buenas prácticas, herramientas y metodologías actuales del sector tech.

· Flexibilidad real con nuestro modelo Flexology: trabaja desde casa, en nuestros centros o desde donde tu talento fluya mejor. Tú eliges.

· Retribución flexible para optimizar tu salario, con ventajas fiscales en tickets restaurante, transporte, guardería, seguro médico y más, adaptados a ti

· Formación continua y desarrollo profesional, con acceso a certificaciones y herramientas digitales como LinkedIn Learning para que nunca dejes de crecer

· Un entorno BabyFriendly, donde celebramos cada nuevo bebé con un kit especial y promovemos la conciliación para avanzar en igualdad

· Un ambiente colaborativo, cercano y con propósito, donde trabajamos en equipo, compartimos retos y celebramos cada logro.




COMPROMISO CON LA IGUALDAD

Plexus Tech mantiene un compromiso firme con las políticas de Igualdad de empresa. Todos nuestros procesos de selección tienen en cuenta la igualdad de oportunidades entre hombres y mujeres de forma transversal, quedando esto reflejado en nuestro Plan de Igualdad.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
En Carrefour estamos transformando nuestros sistemas centrales para modernizar nuestra actividad principal, el comercio al por menor.




Si quieres ser parte de una empresa dinámica, dentro de un sector con gran potencial de desarrollo que te ofrecerá oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y personal, nos encantará tener la oportunidad de conocerte.




Buscamos un/una Data Analyst para nuestra Dirección de Seguros con el objetivo de analizar los datos de la compañía con eje cliente a través de la minería de los datos, a partir de distintas fuentes y sobre un entorno Big Data y con el objetivo de transformarlos en información accionable para la compañía y generar informes y visualizaciones de datos útiles para la toma de decisiones. Discriminar y separar los datos para ofrecer información relevante a sus clientes. Potenciar e impulsar nuevos planteamientos de análisis orientados al cliente con el objetivo de realizar aportaciones de valor a las unidades de negocio.




Entre sus funciones principales se encuentran:




-Tener una visión clara de negocio con el fin de ayudar a los equipos a mejorar su toma de decisiones con respecto al cliente.

- Ofrecer una visualización de los datos que permita su mejor entendimiento por sus clientes.

- Aportar análisis cuantitativos basados en el histórico de datos internos de los clientes para ofrecer previsiones de comportamiento del mismo a Negocio, con el objetivo de ajustar los esfuerzos comerciales a la tendencia del cliente

- Análisis e interpretación de los resultados a partir de distintas técnicas avanzadas (regresiones, algoritmos matemáticos avanzados…) y de herramientas analíticas para detectar las causas raíz de problemas de áreas de negocio .




Nos encantaría conocerte si cuentas con:




-Titulación de Ingeniero Superior, Matemático o Estadístico.

-Experiencia de 2 años en puestos similares.

-Ingles nivel medio-alto.

-Bases Datos SQL y Data Mining.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido

Salario competitivo (fijo + variable)

Descuento del 8% para ti y para 6 personas más en nuestras tiendas

Programas que se preocupan por tu bienestar:

Carrefour Life (actividades y eventos deportivos, descuentos y ventajas exclusivas)

Carrefour Flexible (retribución flexible para seguro médico, guarderías, transporte…)

Formación continua

Desarrollo profesional




Valoraremos todas las candidaturas interesadas y si eres la persona seleccionada para avanzar en el proceso, nos pondremos en contacto contigo para darte más detalles del puesto y conocer tu perfil.




En Carrefour apostamos por un espacio de trabajo idóneo para que cualquier persona con independencia de su género, orientación sexual, identidad y/o expresión de género, creencias, ideologías, origen, capacidades, entre otras, pueda desplegar todo su potencial.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
¿Qué es Hamelyn?

Somos una empresa tecnológica española que está transformando el mercado de segunda mano. Comprar online es fácil, pero ¿qué pasa con vender lo que ya no necesitas? En Hamelyn, hacemos que vender tus cosas usadas sea fácil y rápido. Y las revendemos dando un servicio profesional.




Empezamos con libros, y ya hemos añadido música, películas y videojuegos. Y próximamente tendremos nuevas categorías. Ambicionamos ser la aplicación a la que todos acuden para vender sin complicaciones y para comprar productos de segunda mano con el mismo nivel de calidad y servicio que al comprar productos nuevos.




Hoy, Hamelyn atiende a miles de vendedores y compradores diariamente, procesando cientos de miles de productos al mes y enviando pedidos de todas nuestras categorías desde nuestro centro logístico de Madrid a todo el mundo.




Si quieres saber más sobre la historia de Hamelyn, aquí tienes la entrevista de Itnig a nuestros fundadores: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MGkTWW2rVAc&t=10s




Ahora estamos creciendo rápidamente y construyendo una infraestructura de datos a la altura del negocio. Necesitamos un Data Analyst que trabaje mano a mano con el Data Lead.




🚀¿Listo para construir el futuro con Hamelyn?🚀

Buscamos un experto en convertir datos en decisiones, riguroso con la calidad de la información y con criterio de negocio. Reportarás al Data Lead.




🎯 Misión:

Analizar los datos de Hamelyn para impulsar decisiones de negocio y mejoras en producto y tecnología.




🔥 En qué trabajarás:

Operamos en múltiples países con más de 30 millones de productos catalogados e integrados con marketplaces como Amazon, eBay y MercadoLibre. Esto es lo que tenemos por delante:

Analizar datos clave del negocio para detectar patrones, tendencias y oportunidades (pricing, catálogo, conversión, supply, operaciones).
Definir y mantener métricas y fuentes de verdad (dashboards, tablas base, documentación) para que el equipo tome decisiones rápido.
Construir y validar modelos analíticos o predictivos: datasets, features, validaciones y medición de impacto.
Colaborar con producto y negocio para traducir preguntas en hipótesis, experimentos y decisiones medibles.
Automatizar procesos de reporting.




Requisitos clave:

Dominio de SQL y Python para análisis de datos.
Bases sólidas en estadística aplicada (tests, segmentación, cohortes, funnels).
Experiencia en product analytics / growth analytics (experimentos, atribución, conversión, retención).
Buen criterio para definir métricas (North Star, guardrails) y diseñar reporting útil y accionable.
Capacidad para comunicar hallazgos y proponer acciones a stakeholders no técnicos.
Mentalidad hands-on y autonomía.




Qué ofrecemos:

Salario: 30.000 - 45.000€ según experiencia + variable del 10%
Stock options.
Modelo híbrido orientado a productividad.
Seguro de salud privado.
Servicio de comida y gimnasio.
Presupuesto de formación continua.
Sin burocracia, enfoque a resultados.
Un equipo joven, pragmático y ambicioso centrado en resultados reales y en hacer crecer el negocio.

Si buscas un proyecto ambicioso donde aplicar tus capacidades con resultados visibles, y seguir creciendo en una empresa de rápida expansión, te estamos esperando! 🙌

Title: Developer Data

¡Bienvenido al lugar que te mereces!

Buscamos un/a Developer Data con experiencia en proyectos end-to-end de analítica de datos, valorando conocimiento en lenguajes como Python, PySpark y SQL. Así como conocimiento y/o experiencia en modelos de machine learning y tecnologías de IA.




Te buscamos, independientemente de tu género, capacidades diferentes, orientación sexual, origen étnico o cualquier característica que te haga único/a.

Mentalidad orientada a producto y negocio, con capacidad para priorizar requerimientos en entornos dinámicos y ágiles.
Valorables conocimientos relacionados con la prevención de Fraude, el Blanqueo de Capitales y los Riesgos Financieros.
Experiencia en lenguajes como Python, PySpark y SQL.
Conocimiento y experiencia en la aplicación de modelos de Machine Learning y tecnologías de Inteligencia Artificial.
Conocimientos sólidos en arquitecturas de datos en la nube AWS o Google Cloud Platform) con experiencia con herramientas de visualización de datos como QuickSight y Google Data Studio.

Garantizar el conocimiento, la disponibilidad y la calidad de los datos necesarios, promoviendo su correcta explotación mediante las herramientas, tecnologías y capacidades analíticas disponibles. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
YoBrands, part of The Rank Group, is a leading online gaming operator in the Spanish & Portuguese markets with an expanding online and offline portfolio focused on bingo, casino and sports betting with 4 leading brands: Enracha, YoCasino, YoBingo and YoSports

Our goals are to provide entertainment and community to our customers with our websites and apps so that they can access our products from their mobile phones, tablets while communicating with one another.

We offer our own bingo and slots software and more than 2000 games from the best game providers. We also offer live shows such as El Show De YoBingo and YoSports TV!

With offices based in Barcelona, Ceuta & Malta we always strive to bring joy and security to our customers. Additionally, we will be launching soon in other regulated markets!

Job Purpose

Provide insightful, actionable analyses through dashboards, and reports, to impact our revenue, productivity, acquisition, attrition, operational efficiencies, cross-sell strategies, customer behavior, and segmentation.

This role comes with a high rate of exposure to various parts of the business due to regular senior stakeholder engagement.

Main Accountabilities And Responsibilities


Extract, transform and load data from different data sources.
Work with existing and new technologies to shape the development of analytical insight delivery.
Translates customer, transactional and behavioral data into key insights and business deliverables.
Presents findings to key stakeholders, and inputs to negotiations on strategies to drive performance across the business.
Collaborating with team members and stakeholders to build data products that enable others to work with reporting effectively and inform decision-making that solve business problems with data.
Engage with Key stakeholders to develop key metrics to measure business performance.


Knowledge, Expertise And Qualifications


Demonstrated ability to build solutions and user-friendly dashboards and reports using BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
Experience working with ETL tools (Databricks is a plus).
Experience manipulating data stored in relational databases using SQL (proficiency SQL level required).
Familiar with Agile methodology (JIRA).
Experience engaging with key stakeholders.
Ability to work as part of a team delivering solutions that can be deployed into production.
Ability to take initiative and work independently to manage and deliver end-to-end solutions.
Excellent experience working in a data driven environment.
Ability to gather requirements and map business needs to KPI dashboards.
Creative, innovative thinker with outstanding problem-solving skills.
Meticulous and thorough, with a healthy respect for quality & standards.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to communicate results to non-technical audiences.
Essential: very good knowledge of English at all levels and native-level Spanish.
Degree qualified.


Personal Qualities


Demonstrate sense of passion and pride about own work.
Positive attitude and adapts well to change.
Foster curiosity which results in new lines of thinking, original insight, and breakthrough ideas for the business.
Encourage and challenge others to investigate and explore alternative solutions and ideas.
Ability to translate and clearly formulate technical issues and solutions to the issues.
Excellent problem solving and analysis skills.
Excellent communication skills- written and verbal.
Excellent presentational skills.
Intervenes if warning signs of problems occur within own area of responsibility.
Forward thinking. Proactive rather than Reactive.
Positive and constructive minded.
Takes responsibility for continuous self –learning.
Attention to detail.


Join us to unlock benefits and opportunities that will boost your career journey in a vibrant, inclusive and fulfilling work environment – so you can #BeYourself

Wellbeing@Rank is important... From hybrid working and colleague support networks to menopause support and weekly PepTalks, we’re here for you.

We’ll also invest in your growth by providing development opportunities, leadership training and cutting-edge industry certifications so you have the tools and resources to help you work, win and grow with us.

Immerse yourself in new cultures and gain international exposure through our global business. Collaborate with colleagues from around the globe.

From pensions to bonus schemes, and private medical insurance to life insurance – we've got you covered.


Our benefits vary by brand and/or location. Please have a chat with your local Talent Acquisition specialist to find out what’s in place in your location.


We are committed to being an inclusive employer, ensuring that we better understand and meet the needs and requirements of our candidates and customers.

We aim to do this by facilitating fair and equal access to our services. If you require a reasonable adjustment to be made, please reach out to let us know ahead of your interview.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Marketplace Analytics
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

This role is embedded within either the B2B or Customer Care domain and is part of Preply’s Data Chapter. You will work closely with directors, operations leaders, and cross-functional partners across finance and product teams, while collaborating with data analysts, data scientists, and analytics engineers to strengthen analytical foundations and business impact.

What you’ll be doing:


You will partner with senior stakeholders in Business and Operations teams to proactively identify where new analyses, metrics, or frameworks can unlock improvements in retention, revenue, and operational efficiency.
Lead high-complexity, end-to-end analytical initiatives, from ambiguous problem framing to business impact, uncovering root causes and hidden drivers behind key performance metrics such as revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, operational metrics, and cost efficiency
Design and validate KPI frameworks to ensure consistency, reliability, and cross-team alignment; clarify trade-offs in definitions and measurement logic across Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Product
Design executive-ready storytelling and structured presentations that align stakeholders around shared goals, timelines, and trade-offs
Embed analytics into daily workflows by partnering with business and operational leaders to integrate dashboards, forecasting, and reporting into decision-making processes
Translate insights into strategic decisions, clearly articulating what was observed, why it matters, opportunity cost, and what action should follow, influencing roadmap, prioritisation, and resource allocation


What you need to succeed:


5+ years of experience in analytics roles (Business, Product, Growth, B2B, or Operations), with demonstrated ownership of KPI frameworks and measurable impact on retention, revenue, or efficiency
Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect analytical insights to financial impact, opportunity cost, and roadmap prioritisation.
Strong SQL skills with the ability to independently build and optimise complex queries

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup transforming the industry — from enhancing guest experiences to driving business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners, including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, and Google Travel, Guesty empowers property managers to deliver exceptional guest experiences while running efficient, data-driven operations.

Today, we're proud to have 800+ team members across 16 countries, all working together to shape the future of hospitality technology.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Marketing organization. This role will partner closely with Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver actionable insights, develop scalable reporting, analyze campaign performance, and help optimize marketing strategies through data. The ideal candidate has strong SQL expertise, experience with BI tools, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the primary analytics partner for the Marketing team.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI tools.
Analyze marketing performance across Google Ads, Facebook Ads, email, paid search, paid social, and organic channels.
Define, monitor, and report on key marketing KPIs, including ROI, ROAS, CAC, LTV, attribution, conversion rate, marketing spend, and campaign performance.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through data analysis.
Partner with Marketing, Product, and Business teams to support strategic decision-making.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reporting accuracy across dashboards and reports.
Continuously improve reporting processes through automation and scalable analytics solutions.


Requirements:


3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Marketing Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Analyst.
Expert-level SQL skills with experience writing complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, aggregations, query optimization, and data transformation). This is a core requirement.
Strong experience using BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify actionable insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience building dashboards, reports, and executive-level presentations.
Experience defining and tracking KPIs and business metrics.
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong English communication skills.


Highly Preferred


Experience as a Marketing Data Analyst within a SaaS, IT, software, or technology company.
Experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or similar marketing platforms.
Strong understanding of marketing metrics, including: ROI, ROAS, Attribution, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), Marketing Spend, Conversion Rate
Experience supporting B2B SaaS marketing teams.
Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is an advantage.
Experience with AI tools or analytics automation is a plus.


Join us and discover a workplace where career growth, collaboration, and enjoyment can all exist together.

Design and implement customer journey tracking mechanisms.
Extract, prepare, and explore data from multiple sources to uncover actionable insights, possibly by joining several data sources.
Design dashboards in Tableau for structured or ad-hoc visualizations.
Create automated reporting solutions using tools like SQL, Python or Tableau to streamline regular reporting tasks and reduce manual efforts.
Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns, correlations, and insights within the data.
Support OKR tracking by aligning data metrics to business objectives and monitoring performance over time.
Collaborate closely with business analysts, developers, data engineers and other stakeholders to translate business needs into data requirements.

3–5 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, ideally with exposure to AI/ML use cases.
Proficiency in SQL, Python, and Tableau (or equivalent BI tools).
Ability and willingness to understand the business context and why behind technical features.
Hands-on mindset, comfortable with day-to-day operational work and proactive engagement.
Strong communicator able to bridge business and technical stakeholders.
Experience with Product Analytics is a big plus.
Some knowledge of LLMs, chatbots, and AI customer service solutions is a plus.
Open to occasional travel across Europe.



Preferred Profile:


Someone with a strong analytical foundation, curiosity for AI and a customer-first mindset.
Comfortable in cross-functional, agile teams, ideally experienced with customer-facing products.
Experience working in nearshore teams for enterprise clients is advantageous

Permanent contract
30 working days of vacation
Flexible working hours
Recognition bonus system
Private health insurance
Apple work equipment

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho


Información adicional

💶 Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

🧠 Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

🔎 Nuestro proceso de selección 🔎

✅ Primer match – Una charla con Alejandro (TAP).

📚 Prueba técnica - Para entender bien tus conocimientos básicos del rol.

💡 Conversación estratégica – Intro call con Elias, tu próximo manager.

👉 Presentación de un Business Case - Con Elias.

Title: Data Analyst II Rider Experience
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

YOUR WORK-LIFE OPPORTUNITY:

Join our team and become an integral part of Glovo's Global Logistics! We provide a dynamic and challenging environment filled with numerous opportunities for growth and development.

In this role, you will be responsible for redesigning, testing, and implementing the payment structures that motivate and reward our riders worldwide. By blending deep data analysis and data modeling with creative problem-solving, your work will ensure our logistics network is efficient, scalable, and fair for our riders. The KPIs you will influence are crucial to operations, as every decision made will directly affect the whole operational investment (biggest company cost).

Be a Part Of a Team Where You Will


Explore and find the most optimal logistics payment structure in order to maximize global riders engagement.
Strategically redesign our courier payment framework to improve key operational metrics, designing models that reward factors like vehicle used, distance, weight, and peak-hour availability.
Dive deep into massive datasets to identify trends, drivers, and opportunities. Your insights will be the foundation for optimizing our entire operational investment.
Own the experimentation process to validate your ideas. You will design, run, and analyze experiments (A/B testing, switchback tests) to precisely measure the impact of payment structure changes before a global rollout.
Continuously monitor the performance of your strategies. You will track KPIs, assess the effectiveness of your changes, and make data-driven adjustments as needed.
Understand and address local and regional needs by stepping into the shoes of the riders and truly understanding their perspective.


Qualifications

YOU HAVE


Degree in Engineering, Maths or another STEM field.
2+ years of experience in a data analytics role where you translated insights into tangible business actions and measured their impact.
Strong technical proficiency
Advanced SQL for complex querying and data extraction.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and data orchestration.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. You are comfortable breaking down ambiguous, complex problems into manageable steps and driving towards a clear solution.
Nice to have experience with experimentation. Designing and/or analyzing A/B tests or other statistical testing methodologies to measure impact.
Comfortable working in a high-growth and high-performance environment, dealing with ambiguity while maintaining a positive mindset.
You can clearly and concisely explain complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent English is a must.
You are organized, take ownership of your work, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Additional Information

Individuals representing diverse profiles, and abilities, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We Believe Driven Talent Deserves


💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.
🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.


At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho


Información adicional

💶 Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

Title: Data Analyst | Power BI, SQL y Cultura People First
Description:
¿Te apasiona descubrir historias detrás de los datos y transformarlas en decisiones que mejoran la vida de las personas?




En Eurofirms Group, creemos que los datos son poderosos… pero las personas lo son aún más.

Aquí podrás unir análisis, tecnología e impacto humano en cada proyecto. Cada dato cuenta una historia y cada historia impulsa un cambio real.







🌟 Beneficios que marcarán la diferencia




💬 Cultura y valores humanos

No eres un número: se valora quién eres, no solo tu rol.
Escucha activa y validación constante, tanto profesional como personal.
Valores reales: respeto, responsabilidad y transparencia.




🤝 Compañerismo y equipo

Ambiente cercano, colaborativo y sin jerarquías rígidas.
Ayuda mutua y vínculos reales entre compañeros.
Líderes accesibles que te acompañan y enseñan.




📈 Crecimiento y aprendizaje

Empresa en expansión (más de 1.600 personas).
Oportunidades constantes para aportar ideas y crecer.
Interacción con perfiles diversos y enriquecedores.




🌿 Bienestar y conciliación

2 días de teletrabajo a la semana.
Horario de entrada y salida flexible
Tarde libre semanal.
Fruta gratis en la cantina.
Actividades de equipo y buen humor en el día a día.




🛡️ Reconocimiento y espacio propio

Día libre en tu cumpleaños.
A partir del segundo año de antigüedad, mutua de salud gratuita + descuentos familiares.
Retribución flexible con Cobee (transporte, guardería, seguro médico).
Acceso a Wellhub: gimnasios, nutrición, salud mental.




🫶 En Eurofirms Group creemos en el talento único de cada persona y sabemos que la diversidad aporta valor a los equipos, impulsando organizaciones más innovadoras, creativas y eficientes. Por eso, de acuerdo con nuestra cultura People First, trabajamos para generar entornos laborales inclusivos en los que cada individuo pueda crecer y desarrollar su mejor versión. Asimismo, buscamos actuar como agentes de cambio para promover la igualdad de oportunidades en nuestro entorno, fomentando el respeto y apostando por la diversidad en todas sus formas.




🚀 Tu misión

Tu misión principal será la de analizar los datos subyacentes a los procesos de las personas que componen una organización, con el objetivo de obtener datos cuantificables que se puedan emplear en la toma de decisiones, a través de la estadística aplicada a los procesos de RRHH permitiendo una mejora y automatización en su gestión.




En tu día a día:

Diseñarás soluciones de análisis que respondan a retos reales del negocio.
Crearás dashboards y visualizaciones en Power BI que guíen decisiones estratégicas.
Colaborarás con Data Engineers y Data Scientists para asegurar la calidad y coherencia de los datos.
Realizarás consultas y análisis en SQL, generando información precisa y accionable.
Traducirás datos complejos en historias que inspiren a actuar.




🎯 Qué te hará tener éxito en esta posición




✅ Dominio técnico y curiosidad constante

Conocimientos en Power BI, SQL, Excel y modelado te darán autonomía para avanzar; la curiosidad te mantendrá creciendo cada día.




✅ Visión global y pensamiento estructurado

Entender cómo se conectan los sistemas y procesos te ayudará a construir modelos de datos sólidos y sostenibles.




✅ Comunicación visual y storytelling

Transformarás la información en historias comprensibles, que inspiren decisiones y generen impacto real.




Requisitos:

Formación universitaria preferiblemente técnica (Matemáticas, Estadística, Ingeniería Informática, Física u otras ingenierías)
Conocimientos en estadística
Conocimiento de Conceptos de Business Intelligence
Conocimientos en analítica avanzada
Herramientas de visualización de datos (Power BI, Tableau,)
Conocimientos en Metodologías de la investigación
Habilidades de manejo de datos
Nociones de Data Science
Programación (SQL; R; Python; SPSS)
Gestión del talento




💡 Así es trabajar en el equipo de Data

Nuestros Data Analysts lo resumen así:

“La gente no duda en dejar lo que está haciendo para ayudarte.”
“Hay apoyo constante: técnico, humano y de negocio.”
“No hay competencia interna, todo el mundo rema en la misma dirección.”
“Si entras como júnior, no te sientes solo ni un peso para el equipo.”
"Desde el primer día me sentí acompañado, con personas que realmente querían que aprendiera y creciera.”




Trabajamos con metodologías ágiles, dailys cortas y mucha autonomía.

Tendrás un/a buddy que te acompañará en tu adaptación, tanto técnica como culturalmente.

Aquí las ideas se escuchan, las decisiones se comparten y el crecimiento se impulsa desde la confianza.




👉 Tu siguiente paso

Si te motiva aprender, trabajar con buena gente y usar los datos para generar impacto real, esta oportunidad es para ti.




En Eurofirms Group te unirás a una empresa donde la innovación se hace con propósito y las personas son el centro de todo. Podrás trabajar desde nuestros servicios corporativos en Cassà de la Selva (Girona).




🔥 Aplica ahora y da el siguiente paso en tu carrera con un equipo que te hará brillar.

Porque los datos son poderosos… pero las personas lo son aún más.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Expansion
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team

The Business Strategy Analytics team's mission is to transform data into strategic insights that empower our leaders to make informed decisions, effectively track progress, and unlock growth opportunities. Through deep metric understanding, holistic business views, and detailed analytics, we enable concrete actions that drive business success.

What You’ll Be Doing


Partner with Expansion leadership on major transformation initiatives shaping the value proposition, business model, customer experience, monetization strategy, and operational playbook for new geographies, segments, and product lines.
Evaluate and prioritize new market entries, customer segments, and strategic bets through rigorous market sizing, competitive benchmarking, and customer analysis
Run focused, data-driven deep dives into expansion-stage customer behavior, unit economics, funnel performance, and competitive dynamics to surface where to double down and where to pivot.
Lead cross-functional performance analyses across Expansion workstreams — surfacing trends, explaining the drivers behind new-market KPIs, and delivering clear, actionable insights to the executive team.
Build the analytical models that underpin Expansion decisions: market sizing and TAM/SAM/SOM models, ramp and forecasting models for new launches, scenario models to pressure-test strategic options, and financial models to quantify the upside (and downside) of each bet.


What You Need To Succeed


5+ years of experience in business analytics, product analytics, consulting, or a related analytical role.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, capable of influencing Leadership-level stakeholders.
Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
A proactive, curious mindset with a drive to investigate discrepancies and identify opportunities.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives.
Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous, structured approach to analysis.
Proven Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills (e.g., driver-based modeling, sensitivity analysis, financial impact estimation).
Experience leading cross-functional analytics projects and engaging diverse stakeholders.


Nice to have


Experience in corporate strategy or strategic consulting, with a track record of supporting senior leadership on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives
Experience in fast-growing, data-driven startups, marketplaces, or subscription businesses
Hands-on experience with Looker and Snowflake


Why you’ll love it at Preply


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking a Senior Product Data Analyst to join our Experiments & Insights team in Barcelona (hybrid) to help different teams across the organization to succeed in their mission by providing insights generation and data analysis support in a healthy data-informed environment. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.


We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts



Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. Our Experiments and Insights team is the centre of excellence for Online (AB) Experimentation and for providing best practices to generate insights and learning from and for the experiments.

In this role, you would be performing as a product data analyst (tasks are described below) to support a set of product teams, but you will be also part of the next experimentation generation at eDreams Odigeo. The team is constantly investigating best in class methodologies and processes to implement in our business/analysis and tests, which means you will be required to apply your mathematical knowledge in some strategic projects that are focused on taking more accurate decisions maintaining a strong statistical confidence level. Your will be working with multi-disciplinary teams - Qualitative Researchers, Designers, Product Owners, Developers, and Pricing Managers - to blend different statistical and data analytics techniques to generate a holistic understanding of the users and markets.

As a Product Data Analyst inside the team, you will be in charge of:


Analyse performance and identify behaviours in our different websites and interfaces related to our products;
Analyse performance and user behaviours in the A/B Tests experiments or Pre-Post run by the product teams;
Help the product teams to generate their testing hypotheses by providing exploratory analysis about our products, past tests, etc,
Data cleaning and validation,
Definition of new tracking that will all mostly be added in Google Analytics (to be able to answer different kinds of research/product questions);
Build and maintain dashboards (mostly using LookerStudio) and/or reports (mostly in Google Sheets) to share performance information with senior management and C-level stakeholders;
Lead data-driven initiatives to improve company decision making and business knowledge;
Responsible for one or more team’s projects such as the investigation and implementation of new methodologies, new data analysis techniques or the usage of new tools;
Collaborate with user researchers and designers to detect gaps in knowledge about our user; identify research opportunities to fill those gaps.
NOTE: Data you will be using could come from Google Analytics API or Google Analytics tables in BigQuery, other sources of data stored in BigQuery such as internal databases, customer service database, etc., as well as our data stored and accessible in Microstrategy.



What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline is a requirement (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.),
Minimum of 6 years experience in a role with strong analytical component,
Previous experience in user behavior analysis (product performance) using data from any of the following: Google
Analytics/Adobe Analytics/Mix Panel/ Amplitude/Matomo.
Strong knowledge of the math and statistical concepts behind A/B testing,
Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement, as well as experience in working with databases and large sets of data,
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc),
Knowledge of visualisation tools like LookerStudio, Tableau, Looker or Qlikview,
Business Proficiency in English,
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!



It would be a plus if you have:


R or Python programming skills (mostly for data extraction and data manipulation),
Google Analytics knowledge (as well as Google Analytics API, googleAnalyticsR library for R, GA4, etc.),
Previous experience in programming,
Knowledge on data structure and data sets management in Google Cloud Platform.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence & Data Analyst
Description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Sr Business Intelligence and Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and governing scalable business intelligence solutions and data architectures. The role enables data-driven decision-making across the EMEA commercial organization by transforming complex, multi-source data into actionable insights through robust data models, optimized pipelines, and Power BI reporting.

This position reports to the Head of Commercial Excellence and Business Analytics (EMEA) and is part of the EMEA Sales Operation and Enablement team and will be in Barcelona (Spain) or Prague (Czech Republic) and will be an on-site role.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To


Design and deliver end-to-end Power BI solutions, including robust data models, interactive dashboards, and scalable semantic layers (e.g., star schemas and data marts).
Build and optimize high-performance data architectures by integrating multiple enterprise sources (ERP, CRM, CPQ) and developing efficient SQL queries.
Establish and govern KPI frameworks to ensure consistency, reliability, and alignment across business reporting.
Drive data quality, governance, and best practices in data transformation, normalization, documentation, and access control.
Perform advanced analytics, including exploratory data analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling to support sales and performance tracking.


The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include


B.Sc./M.Sc. in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or related field.
Strong experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard design).
Solid knowledge of data architecture principles (data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing).
Proficiency in SQL and working with relational databases.
Experience integrating data from CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), ERP, and other enterprise systems.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements


Ability to travel 10%


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:


Sales Operations, preferably in Sanitary/Pharmaceutical Sector is a plus
Lean Change Management Models, data-driven transformation and continuous improvement methodologies in fast-paced, evolving environments with shifting priorities
Experience with Lean or data-driven transformation methodologies is a plus.


Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefits that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programmes contribute to life beyond the job.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Sr Business Intelligence and Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and governing scalable business intelligence solutions and data architectures. The role enables data-driven decision-making across the EMEA commercial organization by transforming complex, multi-source data into actionable insights through robust data models, optimized pipelines, and Power BI reporting.

This position reports to the Head of Commercial Excellence and Business Analytics (EMEA) and is part of the EMEA Sales Operation and Enablement team and will be in Barcelona (Spain) or Prague (Czech Republic) and will be an on-site role.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

  • Design and deliver end-to-end Power BI solutions, including robust data models, interactive dashboards, and scalable semantic layers (e.g., star schemas and data marts).
  • Build and optimize high-performance data architectures by integrating multiple enterprise sources (ERP, CRM, CPQ) and developing efficient SQL queries.
  • Establish and govern KPI frameworks to ensure consistency, reliability, and alignment across business reporting.
  • Drive data quality, governance, and best practices in data transformation, normalization, documentation, and access control.
  • Perform advanced analytics, including exploratory data analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling to support sales and performance tracking.

  • B.Sc./M.Sc. in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or related field.
  • Strong experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard design).

  • Experience integrating data from CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), ERP, and other enterprise systems.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Sales Operations, preferably in Sanitary/Pharmaceutical Sector is a plus
  • Lean Change Management Models, data-driven transformation and continuous improvement methodologies in fast-paced, evolving environments with shifting priorities
  • Experience with Lean or data-driven transformation methodologies is a plus.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Growth)
Description:
⭐ Who we are

Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.

Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.




⭐ Role Overview




The Growth Enablement Team is the connective tissue of our Growth organization: we don't optimize a single funnel stage, we build the foundations that let every Growth squad (Acquisition, Activation & Retention, Sales, and Partnerships) move faster, measure better, and experiment with confidence.

As a Senior Growth Data Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of marketing technology, data engineering, and growth analytics, spearheading Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), advanced data modeling, and campaign performance insights that directly shape multi-channel marketing investment and revenue growth.




You'll own advanced analytics frameworks end-to-end, mentor peers, and set the standard for data quality across the growth org.




⭐ How will you make an impact?

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): You design, calibrate, and maintain Marketing Mix Models to quantify cross-channel marketing performance and guide long-term media spend allocation.
Growth data modelling: You architect scalable data models and analytical schemas that integrate multi-channel marketing, web, and product telemetry into unified growth datasets. You have expertise in the technological stack with BigQuery as the warehouse, DBT for production-grade modelling, RudderStack for event streaming, and Omni as the self-serve BI layer.
Campaign performance & insight generation: You conduct deep-dive exploratory analytics across acquisition channels (paid search, paid social, organic) to surface high-leverage growth opportunities.
AI-enabled analytics and agentic automation: You actively use AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting workflows, and improve insight generation speed across the growth org. You contribute to Lodgify's AI Enablement programme by identifying and deploying analytics automation opportunities.
CRM and lifecycle analytics: You design and implement measurement and incrementality frameworks for event-driven lifecycle workflows, evaluating their short-, mid-, and long-term impact on customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
GEO and AI search measurement: You ****design measurement frameworks for AI search visibility, tracking share of voice in LLM answer engines and attributing traffic contribution from GEO channels where traditional UTM attribution is structurally insufficient.
Data storytelling & executive presentations: You synthesise complex quantitative findings into clear visual artefacts and strategic narratives for marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Attribution and measurement: You own Lodgify's full measurement stack, spanning MMM as the strategic budget allocation layer, incrementally and geo-lift testing to validate true channel impact, and privacy-first server-side event tracking as the data collection standard. You design measurement approaches for AI search and GEO channels where UTM-based attribution is structurally insufficient
Strategic cross-functional alignment: You partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to align growth analytics with core unit economics like CAC and LTV.
Data governance & analytics standards: You establish data documentation, reporting standards, and visualisation guidelines to raise overall analytical quality across the growth organisation.




⭐ What makes you a great fit:

Presentation and Influencing: Crafts compelling presentations that connect technical or functional insights to business outcomes, ensuring clarity and resonance across departments. Uses storytelling and analogies to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus without formal authority. Persuades through evidence-backed recommendations while addressing potential concerns upfront. Shapes direction by influencing decisions in cross-functional initiatives through clear, confident communication.
Data-Driven Mindset: Synthesises complex datasets into concise insights that guide decision makers, e.g., highlighting trends, anomalies, and risks. Uses multiple data sources (quantitative & qualitative) to tell a coherent story, and distinguishes between correlation and causation. Applies strong judgment in interpreting incomplete or noisy data, and articulates limitations. Coaches others in data visualization and storytelling, raising the team’s overall data literacy.
Business Acumen: Translates strategic goals into operational decisions and trade-offs for own work. Anticipates business challenges by integrating customer insights, market trends, and internal data. Builds a solid understanding of how different departments contribute to commercial success. Advocates for initiatives with clearly articulated business impact.
Problem Solving: Anticipates problems before they escalate and proactively mitigates risks. Develops creative, workable solutions to complex, cross-functional challenges. Balances trade-offs between resource constraints, stakeholder needs, and long-term business goals. Critically analyses multiple sources of information, validating credibility before making decisions. Guides colleagues on structured problem-solving techniques and decision-making frameworks.
Stakeholder Management: Anticipates stakeholder concerns and proactively addresses them in planning and delivery. Navigates complex or conflicting stakeholder priorities by facilitating compromise grounded in data and shared outcomes. Builds long-term stakeholder trust through consistent, transparent communication and follow-through. Educates stakeholders on technical or operational constraints to manage expectations and build mutual understanding.
Analytics Expertise Direct hands-on experience with at least one of MMM or incrementality testing. Proven experience with marketing analytics, deep knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and multi-touch attribution to evaluate and optimise growth campaigns.
Growth Data Modelling - Ability to write advanced, production-grade code and build robust data models to transform raw marketing telemetry into scalable analytical structures. Incorporating a privacy-first tracking approaches




Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.

What's in it for you?*

🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 Meal Perk: €150/month allowance on your Alan card + 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.

🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Referrals: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 Social Life: Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued

So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

Title: Data Analyst - Ops
Description:
Embark on an exciting career journey with Optima, recognized as one of the 1000 fastest-growing companies in Europe. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Data Analyt to join our vibrant team.




About Us:




At Optima, we've had a front row seat to the fundamental changes of this industry we know and love. Whether it's a move from third-party data to first-party data, being ahead of the curve in programmatic, and preparing for a new cookieless world, we pride ourselves in removing the hassle. Our publishers can count on revenue streams that are optimized and predictable, so they can continue doing what they do best: inform and entertain global consumers.




Job Description

As a Data Analyst, you'll own the numbers behind our publisher portfolio. You'll turn raw programmatic data into decisions: which publishers to onboard, where revenue is leaking, which levers move yield, and what our commercial teams should do next.

This is a high-ownership role with direct, measurable impact on revenue. You'll work daily with Business Development, Operations, and Demand, and you'll build deep expertise in the programmatic supply chain — SSPs, DSPs, header bidding, ads.txt — from day one. If you want to become genuinely fluent in ad tech data, there are few faster ways to do it.




Responsibilities:




Analysis & insight

Analyze prospective publishers: size the revenue opportunity, model expected yield, and pressure-test assumptions before we commit
Run deep-dive analyses on portfolio performance — yield by placement, format, geo, device, and demand partner — and translate findings into concrete recommendations
Build and maintain the metrics that define how we measure success, and defend their definitions when they're questioned
Identify patterns across publishers that others miss: seasonality, demand-partner behavior, bid-density shifts, traffic-quality signals

Performance monitoring & optimization

Monitor daily performance across the portfolio (impressions, fill rate, CPM, CTR, viewability, revenue) against targets
Catch underperformance early, diagnose root causes with data rather than intuition, and make or recommend the adjustments that fix it
Troubleshoot delivery and discrepancy issues with internal teams and external partners, tracing numbers back through the stack to find where they diverge




Publisher onboarding, technical integration and account operations

Support technical setup of new publishers: ads.txt, ad tags, header bidding configuration, and QA before go-live
Assist the Business Development team with new-publisher onboarding and keep the new-business pipeline data accurate and up to date in our CRM
Support adoption of our sales tools and processes across the region

Data quality & reporting

Own the integrity of our reporting layer: audit dashboards and data sources regularly, reconcile discrepancies between platforms, and escalate anomalies fast
Automate recurring reporting so the team spends its time on decisions, not on assembling spreadsheets
Produce clear, accurate performance reporting for publishers and internal stakeholders — and make sure the story the numbers tell is the right one
Surface insights and trends that feed commercial and product decisions
Onboarding & technical integration
Support the technical setup of new publishers: ads.txt, ad tags, header bidding configuration, and QA before go-live
Work with Business Development on new-publisher onboarding, and keep pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM










Required Skills and Qualifications:

Strong analytical skills, identify trends and make data-driven decisions and knowledge of the ad-tech universe.
Proficiency with office productivity tools; ability to quickly adapt to new software and systems.
Proficiency in ad serving platforms.
Commitment to maintaining confidentiality regarding company and employee information.
Fluent in English.



Benefits:

Hybrid work model from our Barcelona office. (3 days at the office / 2 days remote)
Remote working during August.
Real ownership from week one, with structured onboarding and mentorship from senior operators.
A clear growth path.
Front-row exposure to a fast-scaling company working with leading publishers.
Paid team lunch every week.
