Title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations Analytics
Description:
Who we are:
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

About The Role
We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Operations Analytics team in Barcelona. You will partner closely with Rover’s Operations org, driving initiatives and supporting analytics towards furthering Rover’s customer experience. This is a high-visibility role involving direct collaboration with a diverse set of stakeholders to define, measure, test and improve the success of customer experience programs and product developments. A key component of this position will be providing product analytics support for our Bookings Confidence team, which aims to tackle customer service improvements through product developments.

The ideal candidate is a passionate problem-solver who comfortably translates ambiguous business challenges into clear questions, deep analysis, and strategic recommendations that drive action.

You’ll be joining an international team, reporting to a Barcelona based Analytics manager, with colleagues and stakeholders split between Barcelona and Seattle. This is a hybrid role: we're in our Poblenou office two days a week (Mondays and Thursdays), so you'll need to be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

Your Responsibilities:


Thought Partnership: Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, making data-driven recommendations on optimization strategies within customer experience
Experimentation: Partner with Product Managers, designers and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments in support of product developments.
Strategic Planning & Measurement: Partner with Ops Program leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health and operational performance, including establishing comprehensive metrics, developing crisp reporting, and setting up monitoring rhythms.
Performance Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of key CX (Customer Experience) operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities, which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
Executive Communication: Develop and present crisp narratives resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
Data Infrastructure Support: Support the construction and maintenance of our core reporting abstractions (built in dbt), BI reporting and AI semantic layers




What we're looking for (must-haves):


At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
You are extremely comfortable with receiving stakeholder questions and independently translating them into clear, actionable analytical problems to solve, all with relative autonomy.
You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists




Nice to Have:


Master’s degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
Ability to code in Python/R
Hands on experience leveraging AI tools for analytics
Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
Hands-on experience in workforce forecasting




Compensation:


In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €47,124 - €60,319. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees
The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process




Benefits of Working at Rover.com:


Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout
Pension plan
Private medical insurance
25 days PTO
Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)
Gym membership
€450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet
Annual €150 wellness reimbursement
Flexible work hours, sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more
Dog-friendly office




Rover is an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive, and inventive environment with the best employees. We’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, and we work to ensure everyone contributes to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, protected veteran status, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Title: Product Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Barcelona
Description:
Location: We are flexible! Come and join us either in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona.

Freenow empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Product Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our product squads, using data to build a flawless product experience. You will join the Product Data Team and work closely with PMs, designers, UX researchers, developers, and other data functions to discover new product opportunities, validate hypotheses, and launch valuable features to our users.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Providing expertise and collaborating with stakeholders to generate new product feature ideas and improvements, and also estimating the potential impact of planned projects.
Continuously engaging with the product squads to gain an understanding of the problems that need to be solved, gathering requirements, and defining the best deliverables to match the business needs.
Having full ownership of your analysis, from ideation to communication of results and making recommendations to all levels of the company including senior management and prioritization committees.
Developing and evaluating A/B test experiments or other analyses to measure and report the performance of released features, ensuring that we are launching the correct changes and features in our apps.
Working closely with our developers and data engineers to create and capture data that is aligned with the business logic and allows modeling and analysis.
Being involved throughout the complete product lifecycle in order to guarantee a data-driven process.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
You will have the opportunity to steer our products, which kind of features should be developed, and which changes should be made to solve hundreds of thousands of users' daily needs.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other fields with a strong mathematical-statistical background
3+ years experience in working as a Data Analyst in a data-driven analytics environment, preferably within tech product organizations, having direct contact with stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical skills, lateral thinking, and proven experience in solving highly challenging problems.
Very good knowledge of SQL, databases, and statistical programming tools (e.g. Python, R) so that exploratory analyses can be performed, reports created and ETLs maintained
Good understanding and hands-on experience in analyzing and interpreting A/B test results, backed by statistical knowledge.
Experience in working with data visualisation tools (e.g.Tableau, Qlikview) and event tracking (e.g. Mixpanel, GA, Firebase)
You are able to communicate findings in a concise and clear manner to a wide variety of stakeholders to support data-driven decision making by using data visualisation and storytelling and have excellent English communication skills.


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


Plus more local benefits depending on your work location!

Title: Data Analyst BI Specialist IT - HQ
Place: El Prat de Llobregat, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
Tus tareas

Buscamos incorporar un/a Analista de Datos / Desarrollador/a BI que actúe como nexo entre las necesidades del negocio y las soluciones analíticas de la compañía.

La persona seleccionada participará en la evolución del ecosistema de datos y reporting, con foco en el análisis del reporting actual, el diseño de nuevos datamarts en BigQuery, la colaboración en el modelado semántico con Dataform y la transición progresiva desde Power BI hacia Looker / LookML.

Se trata de un rol con una fuerte componente analítica y funcional, orientado a hacer que los datos sean accesibles, comprensibles y útiles para los usuarios finales, garantizando al mismo tiempo consistencia métrica, escalabilidad y calidad del dato.

Tus principales responsabilidades serán:


Analizar los informes existentes en Power BI para entender métricas, dimensiones y lógica de negocio
Participar en el diseño y modelado de datamarts en BigQuery como fuente única de verdad para el reporting.
Colaborar en la creación, evolución y mantenimiento de la capa semántica en Dataform y, progresivamente, en LookML.
Simplificar, validar y estandarizar métricas e indicadores junto con las áreas de negocio.
Adaptar y reconstruir dashboards para consumir los nuevos datamarts y modelos semánticos.
Desarrollar y mantener informes y modelos en Power BI, participando en su evolución futura hacia Looker.
Documentar métricas, reglas de negocio, dimensiones y modelos de datos.
Ejecutar pruebas y validaciones funcionales del dato con usuarios finales.
Actuar como puente entre negocio y tecnología para traducir necesidades analíticas en soluciones claras y sostenibles.
Proponer mejoras en rendimiento, gobernanza del dato, consistencia semántica y usabilidad del reporting


Tu perfil

¿Qué buscamos en ti?


Experiencia en un rol similar dentro del ámbito de BI, analítica o reporting.
Conocimiento de Power BI, incluyendo modelado de datos, DAX y Power Query (M).
Experiencia con Looker y/o LookML.
Nivel avanzado de SQL y capacidad para trabajar con datos en BigQuery.
Experiencia en diseño de datamarts y modelos de datos para BI, especialmente esquemas en estrella.
Capacidad para traducir requerimientos de negocio en soluciones analíticas.
Experiencia en definición, validación y documentación de métricas e indicadores.
Habilidad para trabajar con usuarios finales en procesos de validación y adopción.
Excelente capacidad de comunicación y síntesis.
Inglés alto.


Valorable:


Conocimiento de Dataform
Experiencia previa en entornos GCP.
Experiencia en proyectos de migración o racionalización de reporting.
Conocimiento de herramientas como Git, Jira y Confluence.
Experiencia en sector retail.

¿Quieres formar parte del futuro del retail? Let's Go!

Title: Senior/Expert Data Analyst - Care
Description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market runs on data. Every insight we surface, every model we build, every anomaly we catch is a step toward making refurbished tech the world's obvious choice — not the alternative.

Our Data, Analytics & Insights team is expanding, and we're opening three analytical ownership roles at once: Strategy & Commercial, Customer Care, and Shipping & Logistics.

One application. One process. We'll find the best fit together.

Wherever you land, you'll own a domain end-to-end — from the data model to the boardroom decision. These aren't reporting roles. They're roles where your analytical judgment drives real business direction.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT) 🥇

Customer Care Analytics


Own the measurement of customer satisfaction across all care channels — diagnosing root causes, quantifying downstream impact on retention, and delivering insights that improve operations
Build evaluation frameworks for AI-powered care tools (chatbots, automated resolution, agent assist) — measuring deflection rates, resolution quality, and cost-per-contact
Translate care contact patterns into product root-cause insights that directly reduce Contact Rate and improve Perfect Order Rate


Across All Domains, You'll


Own your analytical domain end-to-end — from data model to decision, you're the go-to person
Partner directly with senior leadership — not just delivering analyses, but shaping the questions we ask
At Staff level: mentor junior analysts and raise the bar for how the team approaches problems


🛠️ Tech Stack

What The Team Works With Day-to-day


Data Warehouse: Google BigQuery
Transformation: dbt
Visualisation & BI: Omni, Amplitude
Languages: SQL (essential), Python (very useful)
Care tooling: Zendesk, Intercom
Experimentation: A/B testing and incrementality frameworks


YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF ⭐

You Have


Strong SQL proficiency and comfort working with large, complex datasets — you can build the query and explain what the result means for the business in the same breath
A track record of owning analytical problem spaces end-to-end — outcomes that shaped business direction, not just answered one-off questions
A rigorous analytical mindset: you understand causal vs. correlational reasoning, know the limits of your data, and can design a measurement framework from scratch
Excellent communication and storytelling skills — you distil complex, multi-variable analyses into crisp narratives that move senior stakeholders to act
Experience in business analytics, commercial strategy, or a customer-facing operations domain (marketplace, e-commerce, logistics, or similar)
5+ years of experience in data analytics, or equivalent hands-on analytical ownership


Nice To Have


Python proficiency for statistical work, modelling, or analytical automation
Domain familiarity: pricing/revenue management for Commercial; care platform experience (Zendesk, Intercom) for Care; logistics or carrier analytics for Shipping
Experience designing experiments in an operational context (A/B tests, holdouts, or incrementality measurement)


Even if you don't tick every box, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse analytical backgrounds and unconventional paths to expertise.

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

Benefits

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:


A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.
Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.
Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.


At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Title: Junior Data Analyst, Solutions & Innovation
Description:
What You'll Do:

At Criteo, we're not just serving ads; we're defining the future of commerce media. With 20 offices worldwide, serving over 18,000 customers, and delivering 5 billion ad impressions daily, our data-scale gives you a unique playground to learn advanced analytics from day one.

As a member of our Analytics Solutions & Innovation (AXSI) team, you'll sit at the intersection of data analysis and consulting. You'll help our commercial teams and clients turn data into decisions: supporting experiments, prototyping new measurement approaches, and learning to translate analysis into recommendations that shape strategy. It's a hands-on entry point into ad-tech analytics, with direct exposure to senior analysts, clients, and modern AI-assisted tooling.


Data-Driven Consulting: Partner with our commercial teams to understand client questions, and help translate data and experiment results into clear recommendations that inform strategic decisions.
Measurement & Analysis: Support the design and execution of analyses from A/B tests to incrementality studies to quantify the value of Criteo's solutions for clients.
Prototyping & Innovation: Get hands-on with tools like Claude Code and Codex to build and prototype analytical solutions, automating workflows and testing new ideas quickly.
Storytelling: Learn to distil complex analysis into simple, compelling narratives for technical and non-technical audiences alike.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside Product, R&D, and commercial teams, contributing to how Criteo measures and demonstrates the value of its advertising solutions.
Tech Stack Exposure: Build fluency across our data stack (SQL, Python, Hadoop, Vertica, Tableau) alongside modern AI-assisted coding tools.



Who You Are:


Up to 1 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related quantitative field (internships count).
Comfortable with SQL and Python, or with a strong eagerness to build that fluency quickly.
Curious about experimentation and statistics: you don't need to be an expert yet, but you're keen to learn.
A clear communicator who can explain data findings simply, even to non-technical audiences.
Comfortable exploring new tools, including AI coding assistants, to solve problems faster.
A collaborative team player who enjoys working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues.



We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!

Who We Are:

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.

📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.

💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.

🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.

💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

Title: Product Analyst, Payments (100% Remote within Spain)
Description:
Welcome to the good side of tech 👋

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

In this role as a Product Analyst at Docplanner you'll own the metrics and analytical direction for your product area, working directly with Product Directors to influence strategy and roadmap priorities. Your insights will drive real decisions: what we build, what we kill, and where we invest next.

This means the autonomy to dig into the problems that matter, challenge conventional thinking, and push for change when the data tells a different story. You'll define what success looks like, build the frameworks to measure it, and make sure every major decision is backed by solid analysis.

You'll work with a talented team of analysts, researchers, product managers, designers, and engineers who are obsessed with building the best product. Your analyses will directly shape Product strategy and influence how millions of patients and healthcare professionals experience Docplanner.

About The Payments Team

DP Payments is a sub-unit of two fully autonomous product teams, PMs, engineers and a designer — with the mandate and capability to work across virtually any app or repository in the Docplanner ecosystem. We're building a new revenue stream for the company, which means combining the maturity of a scale-up with the agility of a startup.

The challenge

Payments has to live inside almost every app and view Docplanner has. We don't get the comfort of a greenfield or a clean separation, but we're held to the expectations of one. The challenge is to keep iterating fast inside a complex ecosystem of mature processes and products.

Key Responsibilities Include


Help product areas to strategically build the product: bring ideas for new growth opportunities based on your expertise, estimate the potential impact of such ideas and guide our strategy through metric frameworks and insights.
Work with higher management, business stakeholders and researchers to create and validate hypotheses from both a qualitative and quantitative perspective.
Create and maintain dashboards, analysis and forecasts related to our team’s main metrics.
Manipulate and transform large data-sets to bring new insights and perform root-cause analysis.
Collaborate with the Product team to test new features and validate hypotheses through experimentation and AB Testing.
Perform segmentation analysis to understand who our customers are and what are their main drivers to engage with our products.
Build, maintain and continuously evolve the analytics stack for a complex set of processes spread across many apps and technologies — centred on accepting and processing patient payments to doctors and clinics for their appointments.


Who are you?


You are curious by nature, and you love to ask and answer questions and dig into data.
You like finding patterns in data and proactively suggesting stakeholders how to improve the product.
You have an excellent understanding of statistics.
You enjoy constant learning and high autonomy.
You enjoy being part of a diverse analytics team.
You enjoy training and coaching others.
You are familiar with complex Product organizations in the SaaS market.
You enjoy using cutting-edge tools, frameworks and incorporating AI to automate and improve your work.


What skills and experiences do we want you to have?


3+ years of relevant experience in analytics, working with business KPIs and metrics, of which 2+ working closely with product managers and user research teams.
You are familiar with the tools that we use:
Proficiency in SQL (essential) and experienced with DBT.
Data visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI or similar (essential)
Event-tracking tools such as Google Analytics, Amplitude or similar (essential)
Python and its ecosystem of Data Science libraries
Experienced in working with Claude Code or similar AI IDEs.
Great communication skills and stakeholder management. You translate complex analyses into clear insights that executives and stakeholders actually act on.
Fluent in manipulating, transforming, and reshaping data, preferably from multiple data sources.
Doing root-cause analysis, applying statistical concepts like regressions, and proving correlations and causation.
Contributing to data warehouses, creating aggregated data sets, general understanding of data pipelines and flows.
Experience designing, implementing and measuring A/B Tests and interpreting the results.
Experience enabling others by training stakeholders on tools and helping teams become more data-literate and autonomous.

Let’s talk money


A salary adequate to your experience: ranging from €46,000 to €56,000 per year.
Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings.


True flexibility and work-life balance


Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona.
Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly).
Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier).
23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays.
Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).


Health comes first


Private healthcare plan with Adeslas for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental).
Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with Andjoy.
Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.


Keep growing with us


Free English and Spanish classes.


We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

Title: ACES Analyst, ADAT
Description:
Description

We are looking for a Business Analyst to join the ACES Data Analytics Team (ADAT) , supporting operational excellence through data-driven dashboarding solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards and underlying data pipelines that provide actionable insights to operations teams. You will work closely with stakeholders across the support function to translate business needs into analytics solutions that drive decision-making and continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities

i) Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that support operational performance tracking and decision-making

ii) Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources

iii) Develop Python scripts for data manipulation, automation, and advanced analytics

iv) Partner with operations stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications

v) Perform root cause analysis on operational metrics, identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement

vi) Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all reporting and dashboarding deliverables

vii) Proactively communicate progress, blockers, and risks to stakeholders and leadership

viii) Support KTLO (Keep The Lights On) activities for existing dashboards, including troubleshooting, bug fixes, and enhancements

A day in the life

In particular, Business Analysts will support the team with different types of analyses (from estimating the savings of a new project to calculating the drivers behind the Team’s performance) and work with various stakeholders in Amazon’s Operations. We are looking for profiles with analytics and communication skills, business sense and an excellent knowledge of Excel and the Microsoft Office package.

As a Business Analyst on our team, you own the full cycle from raw data to actionable insight. You write SQL queries to pull operational data from multiple sources, validate it, and transform it into something meaningful. When something looks off in the numbers, you investigate — tracing it back through the pipeline until you find the root cause and flag it to stakeholders before it becomes a problem.

You build and maintain dashboards in QuickSuite that operations teams rely on daily. That means designing layouts, connecting calculated fields, setting up filters, and making sure the right people see the right data at the right level of detail. You iterate on these based on feedback, always looking for ways to make the information clearer and more useful.

You also write Python scripts that automate repetitive work — data validations, scheduled extractions, report generation — things that used to take hours manually and now run in minutes. When a quick ad-hoc analysis comes in from a manager, you use Excel to pivot the data and deliver a clean summary without overengineering it.

Throughout all of this, you share what you find. You communicate insights clearly to stakeholders, walk them through what the data is telling us, and help them make decisions based on evidence rather than assumptions.

About The Team

Our team sits within the ACES organization and provides analytics and dashboarding solutions that support operational functions. We are a medium size, high-impact team focused on delivering clean, scalable, and well-documented analytics that enable data-driven decision-making across operations. We value seamless development practices, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Experience in a business analyst, data analyst or equivalent role
Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages
iii) Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis across large datasets
vi) Proficiency in Excel for ad-hoc analysis and reporting
vii) Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights to technical and non-technical audiences


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in a logistics/operations environment
Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques
Knowledge of SQL/ETL
Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
Experience in process design and documentation
Familiarity with Amazon's data ecosystem (Redshift, Andes, S3)

You will work closely with stakeholders across the support function to translate business needs into analytics solutions that drive decision-making and continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities

i) Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that support operational performance tracking and decision-making

ii) Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources

iii) Develop Python scripts for data manipulation, automation, and advanced analytics

iv) Partner with operations stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications

v) Perform root cause analysis on operational metrics, identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement

vi) Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all reporting and dashboarding deliverables

vii) Proactively communicate progress, blockers, and risks to stakeholders and leadership

viii) Support KTLO (Keep The Lights On) activities for existing dashboards, including troubleshooting, bug fixes, and enhancements

A day in the life

In particular, Business Analysts will support the team with different types of analyses (from estimating the savings of a new project to calculating the drivers behind the Team’s performance) and work with various stakeholders in Amazon’s Operations. We are looking for profiles with analytics and communication skills, business sense and an excellent knowledge of Excel and the Microsoft Office package.

As a Business Analyst on our team, you own the full cycle from raw data to actionable insight. You write SQL queries to pull operational data from multiple sources, validate it, and transform it into something meaningful. When something looks off in the numbers, you investigate — tracing it back through the pipeline until you find the root cause and flag it to stakeholders before it becomes a problem.

You build and maintain dashboards in QuickSuite that operations teams rely on daily. That means designing layouts, connecting calculated fields, setting up filters, and making sure the right people see the right data at the right level of detail. You iterate on these based on feedback, always looking for ways to make the information clearer and more useful.

You also write Python scripts that automate repetitive work — data validations, scheduled extractions, report generation — things that used to take hours manually and now run in minutes. When a quick ad-hoc analysis comes in from a manager, you use Excel to pivot the data and deliver a clean summary without overengineering it.

Throughout all of this, you share what you find. You communicate insights clearly to stakeholders, walk them through what the data is telling us, and help them make decisions based on evidence rather than assumptions.

Our team sits within the ACES organization and provides analytics and dashboarding solutions that support operational functions. We are a medium size, high-impact team focused on delivering clean, scalable, and well-documented analytics that enable data-driven decision-making across operations. We value seamless development practices, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.

The challenge 🤔

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Commercial Data Insights Team. You will be a member of the technical brain behind the data driven strategy for SEAT and CUPRA. Your mission 🧐


Lead the design, development, and maintenance of Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into insightful, user-friendly reports and visualizations.
Develop and optimize data models by integrating multiple enterprise data sources (ERP, CRM, CPQ, and others), ensuring high performance and scalability.
Establish and maintain KPI frameworks, data governance standards, and reporting best practices to ensure data accuracy, consistency and reliability.
Perform testing, validation, and quality assurance activities to guarantee the integrity and performance of reporting solutions.
Provide advanced analytical insights and recommendations through data exploration, trend analysis and performance monitoring.
Create and maintain technical documentation while driving continuous improvements in reporting capabilities and user experience.


What we offer 🤩

We believe in a mature and balanced work environment. No fireworks, but solid conditions.


Annual gross salary: 45.000-48.000€.
2.200€ per year in social benefits to choose.
2.000€ per year in trainings.
Daily Snacks: We try to promote healthy living habits. You will find in our canteen many nuts, fresh fruit, salads, …
Flexible working hours: We understand the importance of work-life balance.
26 days for your vacations.
Best technology for your needs.
Nice located offices.


Minimum Requirements

What we’re looking for 😊


Education: Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
Fluency in English and Spanish is required.
Experience: 3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence development, with a focus on building semantic models and data analytics.
Strong experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard design).
Proficient in SQL, DAX, Python, or Spark for querying and modelling data.
Experience with ETL tools and data integration (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform).
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud) and data warehousing solutions.
Strong communication skills to bridge the gap between technical teams and stakeholders.
Proven experience in translating business requirements into actionable technical solutions.
Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools.
Strong ability to work autonomously and thrive in collaborative environments
Track record of driving innovation and pushing Power BI capabilities while respecting enterprise governance and security guidelines.
Familiarity with AI-driven capabilities in BI (e.g., Power BI Copilot, automated insights, Chatbot, etc.), combined with a strong drive to experiment, innovate and implement AI-focused improvements.
Experience with other visualization tools like Tableau.
Nice to have: Experience working with digital analytics platforms and web/product data integration (e.g. Adobe Analytics).

B.Sc./M.Sc. in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or related field.
Strong experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard design).
Solid knowledge of data architecture principles (data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing).
Proficiency in SQL and working with relational databases.
Experience integrating data from CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), ERP, and other enterprise systems.

Ability to travel 10%

Lean Change Management Models, data-driven transformation and continuous improvement methodologies in fast-paced, evolving environments with shifting priorities

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Growth)
Description:
⭐ Who we are

Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.

Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.




⭐ Role Overview




The Growth Enablement Team is the connective tissue of our Growth organization: we don't optimize a single funnel stage, we build the foundations that let every Growth squad (Acquisition, Activation & Retention, Sales, and Partnerships) move faster, measure better, and experiment with confidence.

As a Senior Growth Data Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of marketing technology, data engineering, and growth analytics, spearheading Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), advanced data modeling, and campaign performance insights that directly shape multi-channel marketing investment and revenue growth.




You'll own advanced analytics frameworks end-to-end, mentor peers, and set the standard for data quality across the growth org.




⭐ How will you make an impact?

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): You design, calibrate, and maintain Marketing Mix Models to quantify cross-channel marketing performance and guide long-term media spend allocation.
Growth data modelling: You architect scalable data models and analytical schemas that integrate multi-channel marketing, web, and product telemetry into unified growth datasets. You have expertise in the technological stack with BigQuery as the warehouse, DBT for production-grade modelling, RudderStack for event streaming, and Omni as the self-serve BI layer.
Campaign performance & insight generation: You conduct deep-dive exploratory analytics across acquisition channels (paid search, paid social, organic) to surface high-leverage growth opportunities.
AI-enabled analytics and agentic automation: You actively use AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting workflows, and improve insight generation speed across the growth org. You contribute to Lodgify's AI Enablement programme by identifying and deploying analytics automation opportunities.
CRM and lifecycle analytics: You design and implement measurement and incrementality frameworks for event-driven lifecycle workflows, evaluating their short-, mid-, and long-term impact on customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
GEO and AI search measurement: You ****design measurement frameworks for AI search visibility, tracking share of voice in LLM answer engines and attributing traffic contribution from GEO channels where traditional UTM attribution is structurally insufficient.
Data storytelling & executive presentations: You synthesise complex quantitative findings into clear visual artefacts and strategic narratives for marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Attribution and measurement: You own Lodgify's full measurement stack, spanning MMM as the strategic budget allocation layer, incrementally and geo-lift testing to validate true channel impact, and privacy-first server-side event tracking as the data collection standard. You design measurement approaches for AI search and GEO channels where UTM-based attribution is structurally insufficient
Strategic cross-functional alignment: You partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to align growth analytics with core unit economics like CAC and LTV.
Data governance & analytics standards: You establish data documentation, reporting standards, and visualisation guidelines to raise overall analytical quality across the growth organisation.




⭐ What makes you a great fit:

Presentation and Influencing: Crafts compelling presentations that connect technical or functional insights to business outcomes, ensuring clarity and resonance across departments. Uses storytelling and analogies to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus without formal authority. Persuades through evidence-backed recommendations while addressing potential concerns upfront. Shapes direction by influencing decisions in cross-functional initiatives through clear, confident communication.
Data-Driven Mindset: Synthesises complex datasets into concise insights that guide decision makers, e.g., highlighting trends, anomalies, and risks. Uses multiple data sources (quantitative & qualitative) to tell a coherent story, and distinguishes between correlation and causation. Applies strong judgment in interpreting incomplete or noisy data, and articulates limitations. Coaches others in data visualization and storytelling, raising the team’s overall data literacy.
Business Acumen: Translates strategic goals into operational decisions and trade-offs for own work. Anticipates business challenges by integrating customer insights, market trends, and internal data. Builds a solid understanding of how different departments contribute to commercial success. Advocates for initiatives with clearly articulated business impact.
Problem Solving: Anticipates problems before they escalate and proactively mitigates risks. Develops creative, workable solutions to complex, cross-functional challenges. Balances trade-offs between resource constraints, stakeholder needs, and long-term business goals. Critically analyses multiple sources of information, validating credibility before making decisions. Guides colleagues on structured problem-solving techniques and decision-making frameworks.
Stakeholder Management: Anticipates stakeholder concerns and proactively addresses them in planning and delivery. Navigates complex or conflicting stakeholder priorities by facilitating compromise grounded in data and shared outcomes. Builds long-term stakeholder trust through consistent, transparent communication and follow-through. Educates stakeholders on technical or operational constraints to manage expectations and build mutual understanding.
Analytics Expertise Direct hands-on experience with at least one of MMM or incrementality testing. Proven experience with marketing analytics, deep knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and multi-touch attribution to evaluate and optimise growth campaigns.
Growth Data Modelling - Ability to write advanced, production-grade code and build robust data models to transform raw marketing telemetry into scalable analytical structures. Incorporating a privacy-first tracking approaches




Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.

What's in it for you?*

🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 Meal Perk: €150/month allowance on your Alan card + 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.

🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Referrals: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 Social Life: Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued

So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

Title: Data Analyst (CRM)
Description:
We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance


Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs


Experimentation Design & Governance


Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations


Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights


Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns


Data Integrity & Targeting Validation


Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch


What We’re Looking For


4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.


Technical Skills


SQL (required)
Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks


About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Title: Data Analyst - Ops
Description:
Embark on an exciting career journey with Optima, recognized as one of the 1000 fastest-growing companies in Europe. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Data Analyt to join our vibrant team.




About Us:




At Optima, we've had a front row seat to the fundamental changes of this industry we know and love. Whether it's a move from third-party data to first-party data, being ahead of the curve in programmatic, and preparing for a new cookieless world, we pride ourselves in removing the hassle. Our publishers can count on revenue streams that are optimized and predictable, so they can continue doing what they do best: inform and entertain global consumers.




Job Description

As a Data Analyst, you'll own the numbers behind our publisher portfolio. You'll turn raw programmatic data into decisions: which publishers to onboard, where revenue is leaking, which levers move yield, and what our commercial teams should do next.

This is a high-ownership role with direct, measurable impact on revenue. You'll work daily with Business Development, Operations, and Demand, and you'll build deep expertise in the programmatic supply chain — SSPs, DSPs, header bidding, ads.txt — from day one. If you want to become genuinely fluent in ad tech data, there are few faster ways to do it.




Responsibilities:




Analysis & insight

Analyze prospective publishers: size the revenue opportunity, model expected yield, and pressure-test assumptions before we commit
Run deep-dive analyses on portfolio performance — yield by placement, format, geo, device, and demand partner — and translate findings into concrete recommendations
Build and maintain the metrics that define how we measure success, and defend their definitions when they're questioned
Identify patterns across publishers that others miss: seasonality, demand-partner behavior, bid-density shifts, traffic-quality signals

Performance monitoring & optimization

Title: Junior Data Analyst, Solutions & Innovation
Description:
What You'll Do:

At Criteo, we're not just serving ads; we're defining the future of commerce media. With 20 offices worldwide, serving over 18,000 customers, and delivering 5 billion ad impressions daily, our data-scale gives you a unique playground to learn advanced analytics from day one.

As a member of our Analytics Solutions & Innovation (AXSI) team, you'll sit at the intersection of data analysis and consulting. You'll help our commercial teams and clients turn data into decisions: supporting experiments, prototyping new measurement approaches, and learning to translate analysis into recommendations that shape strategy. It's a hands-on entry point into ad-tech analytics, with direct exposure to senior analysts, clients, and modern AI-assisted tooling.


Data-Driven Consulting: Partner with our commercial teams to understand client questions, and help translate data and experiment results into clear recommendations that inform strategic decisions.
Measurement & Analysis: Support the design and execution of analyses from A/B tests to incrementality studies to quantify the value of Criteo's solutions for clients.
Prototyping & Innovation: Get hands-on with tools like Claude Code and Codex to build and prototype analytical solutions, automating workflows and testing new ideas quickly.
Storytelling: Learn to distil complex analysis into simple, compelling narratives for technical and non-technical audiences alike.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside Product, R&D, and commercial teams, contributing to how Criteo measures and demonstrates the value of its advertising solutions.
Tech Stack Exposure: Build fluency across our data stack (SQL, Python, Hadoop, Vertica, Tableau) alongside modern AI-assisted coding tools.



Who You Are:


Up to 1 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related quantitative field (internships count).
Comfortable with SQL and Python, or with a strong eagerness to build that fluency quickly.
Curious about experimentation and statistics: you don't need to be an expert yet, but you're keen to learn.
A clear communicator who can explain data findings simply, even to non-technical audiences.
Comfortable exploring new tools, including AI coding assistants, to solve problems faster.
A collaborative team player who enjoys working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues.



We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.

📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.

💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.

🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.

💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

Title: Product Analyst, Payments (100% Remote within Spain)
Description:
Welcome to the good side of tech 👋

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

In this role as a Product Analyst at Docplanner you'll own the metrics and analytical direction for your product area, working directly with Product Directors to influence strategy and roadmap priorities. Your insights will drive real decisions: what we build, what we kill, and where we invest next.

This means the autonomy to dig into the problems that matter, challenge conventional thinking, and push for change when the data tells a different story. You'll define what success looks like, build the frameworks to measure it, and make sure every major decision is backed by solid analysis.

You'll work with a talented team of analysts, researchers, product managers, designers, and engineers who are obsessed with building the best product. Your analyses will directly shape Product strategy and influence how millions of patients and healthcare professionals experience Docplanner.

About The Payments Team

DP Payments is a sub-unit of two fully autonomous product teams, PMs, engineers and a designer — with the mandate and capability to work across virtually any app or repository in the Docplanner ecosystem. We're building a new revenue stream for the company, which means combining the maturity of a scale-up with the agility of a startup.

The challenge

Payments has to live inside almost every app and view Docplanner has. We don't get the comfort of a greenfield or a clean separation, but we're held to the expectations of one. The challenge is to keep iterating fast inside a complex ecosystem of mature processes and products.

Key Responsibilities Include


Help product areas to strategically build the product: bring ideas for new growth opportunities based on your expertise, estimate the potential impact of such ideas and guide our strategy through metric frameworks and insights.
Work with higher management, business stakeholders and researchers to create and validate hypotheses from both a qualitative and quantitative perspective.
Create and maintain dashboards, analysis and forecasts related to our team’s main metrics.
Manipulate and transform large data-sets to bring new insights and perform root-cause analysis.
Collaborate with the Product team to test new features and validate hypotheses through experimentation and AB Testing.
Perform segmentation analysis to understand who our customers are and what are their main drivers to engage with our products.
Build, maintain and continuously evolve the analytics stack for a complex set of processes spread across many apps and technologies — centred on accepting and processing patient payments to doctors and clinics for their appointments.


Who are you?


You are curious by nature, and you love to ask and answer questions and dig into data.
You like finding patterns in data and proactively suggesting stakeholders how to improve the product.
You have an excellent understanding of statistics.
You enjoy constant learning and high autonomy.
You enjoy being part of a diverse analytics team.
You enjoy training and coaching others.
You are familiar with complex Product organizations in the SaaS market.
You enjoy using cutting-edge tools, frameworks and incorporating AI to automate and improve your work.


What skills and experiences do we want you to have?


3+ years of relevant experience in analytics, working with business KPIs and metrics, of which 2+ working closely with product managers and user research teams.
You are familiar with the tools that we use:
Proficiency in SQL (essential) and experienced with DBT.
Data visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI or similar (essential)
Event-tracking tools such as Google Analytics, Amplitude or similar (essential)
Python and its ecosystem of Data Science libraries
Experienced in working with Claude Code or similar AI IDEs.
Great communication skills and stakeholder management. You translate complex analyses into clear insights that executives and stakeholders actually act on.
Fluent in manipulating, transforming, and reshaping data, preferably from multiple data sources.
Doing root-cause analysis, applying statistical concepts like regressions, and proving correlations and causation.
Contributing to data warehouses, creating aggregated data sets, general understanding of data pipelines and flows.
Experience designing, implementing and measuring A/B Tests and interpreting the results.
Experience enabling others by training stakeholders on tools and helping teams become more data-literate and autonomous.

Let’s talk money


A salary adequate to your experience: ranging from €46,000 to €56,000 per year.
Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings.


True flexibility and work-life balance


Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona.
Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly).
Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier).
23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays.
Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).


Health comes first


Private healthcare plan with Adeslas for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental).
Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with Andjoy.
Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.


Keep growing with us


Free English and Spanish classes.

When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

Title: Fraud Data Analyst

About Us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn't stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.

By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Fraud Data Analyst, you'll be the person who secures the future of digital payments by architecting sophisticated real-time defense strategies.

Here's What Your Day-to-day Will Look Like


Architect Real-Time Strategies – You will be responsible for our real-time decisioning engine, designing and deploying logic that combines ML scores with velocity features to make millisecond decisions.
Precision Rule Development – Translate complex fraud patterns into high-performing rules, optimizing the balance between False Positive Rates (FPR) and Gross Fraud Loss.
Deconstruct Payment Fraud – Proactively hunt for emerging schemes (ATO, social engineering) and turn these insights into end-to-end mitigation strategies.
Optimize the Decisioning Stack – Partner with Product and Engineering to define analytical requirements for new features and third-party data signals.
Calibrate ML & Heuristics – Work with Data Science to operationalize machine learning models, determining how to best "wrap" model scores with heuristic rules.
Champion Frictionless UX – Analyze security measures to identify unnecessary hurdles, designing dynamic friction strategies for a seamless user experience.
Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.


Expect challenges, collaboration, and the freedom to bring your ideas to life in a fast-moving and supportive environment. Things change quickly here, so be ready to adapt, take initiative, and shape your role as we grow.

Who We're Looking For

We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in! Does this sound like you?


Experience – You have between 3 and 7 years of professional experience, specifically within the risk, payments, or credit sectors.
Technical Proficiency – You are highly skilled in SQL and Python for data analysis and strategy development.
Domain Expertise – You have a solid understanding of payment fraud dynamics and experience working with real-time decisioning environments.
